_comment: Copy to ~/.terminal-talk/config.json and edit. All fields optional; defaults apply. The $schema reference above gives VS Code + any editor that honours json.schemas autocomplete + validation on save.

voices._comment: edge_* are free neural voices from Microsoft Edge. openai_* are premium voices used only when an OpenAI key is configured and OpenAI is selected as primary or fallback. Full Edge voice list: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/language-support?tabs=tts

playback._comment: speed 0.5-2.5x. master_volume is 0.0-1.0. collapse_delay_sec is how long the toolbar stays expanded while idle (1-120). auto_prune toggles whether played clips disappear after N seconds (3-600). tts_provider is edge or openai. tts_fallback_provider is edge, openai, or none; default edge keeps fallback free.

dictation._comment: Local Whisper cleanup removes filler words and spoken formatting commands before paste. cleanup_provider 'openai' is opt-in and can spend API credits; it falls back to local cleanup if unavailable.

speech_includes._comment: Global defaults for what gets spoken from assistant responses. tool_calls covers Claude hook events and Codex rollout tool events when available. Per-session overrides live in session-colours.json and win over these.

panels._comment: Toolbar panel state; managed by the app.

create_session_window_placements._comment: Optional advanced recording aid. Keys can be labels like Claude TT A or kind:index values like codex:5. Values can be bounds strings like -1008,-1080,960,516, or objects with windowPosition/windowSize/windowBounds.

window._comment: Populated automatically — last-saved position + dock orientation. Delete these keys to reset to centred-top on next launch.
